capabilities: Create Notion-style folder pages and notes
Add board and timeline views to bases
Show colored select chips and tag colors
Assign note icons across the app
Preview notes in a side peek
disambiguation: Not an official Notion product or a Notion sync integration; it recreates Notion-style pages and databases locally inside Obsidian.
extras: Personal project with no warranty; features built with AI assistance and tested only through the author's six months of daily use. Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later (for Bases). Per-feature docs are on linked external pages. Optional website icons (off by default) send each domain to Google's favicon service; HEIC conversion uses macOS's sips command.
intentEvidence: Plan in a base, then drag the plan.
motivation: Built as a personal project inspired by Notion's ideas, developed for the author's own workflow.
problem: Obsidian lacks Notion-style pages, colored database chips, and board or timeline views for organizing notes.

relations.evidence: inspired by Notion's ideas and the Obsidian community

summary: Notion-inspired feature pack adding folder pages, colored select chips, note icons, board and timeline views, and side peek to Obsidian.
